label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (insecure-randomness) is alert-TP: java.util.Random.nextInt() generates non-cryptographic random numbers used for authentication tokens (rememberMeKey), which is a known weakness. Alert 2 (xss) is alert-FP: the sink expressions at L86-L91 reference rememberMe.getName() and rememberMe.getValue(), which are newly created cookie objects—not user-provided data. User input flows through doSomething() but is not reflected in the printed output.

evidence.note: Cookie rememberMe is freshly created with controlled name/value, not user input
